findings.issue: The relative clause is an assertion (what Jehová speaks, I will speak it). No interrogative token licenses the final question mark.
findings.spanishSpan: lo que hable Jehová, a ello hablaré?

findings.issue: Construct noun מְלֹא בֵיתוֹ is “fullness of his house.” “lleno su casa” leaves that link unmarked, so “lleno” can attach to Balaq.
Qal imperfects are rendered as subjunctive “diera” and conditional “podría,” shifting the open condition toward a counterfactual.
רָעָה is a feminine noun rendered as the adjective “mala,” parallel to the adjective טוֹבָה.

notes: Jehová, Balaq, boca, plata y oro, and the 1cs/3ms speakers match the tokens.
